commitments.detail: Ensure all necessary medications are stocked in the correct concentration.
Provide regular monitoring results to nursing staff.
Train nurses on the use of the new protocol and automated dispensing cabinets.
Set up and test the electronic alert system for the protocol.
Ensure all operational requirements are met before approving the protocol.
Ensure all nursing staff are trained on the new protocol and electronic medication record.
Pharmacy and laboratory will provide regular updates on the protocol's effectiveness and any necessary adjustments.
A review of the protocol will be conducted within 30 days to assess its impact on patient safety.
Pharmacy confirmed the concentration of the anticoagulant.
Laboratory medicine confirmed the monitoring requirements.
Nursing education confirmed the nurse authorization process.
Clinical information technology confirmed the electronic alert system setup.
